intro.text: A noblewoman of Arelon, the wife of Count Ahan and the mother of Torena.

items.text: At a needlepoint gathering of court ladies, Seaden remarked that only priests care which religion a person follows.
Excited by stories, some of them exaggerated, about Teo women and swordplay, Seaden was keen to learn to fence, and she and Torena both joined Sarene's lessons.

The lessons led Seaden to eat better and live more healthily, and she lost weight. Ahan, who liked a fuller figure, was unhappy about it, but she held firm and tried to persuade him to eat better too.

appearance.text: Full-figured at first, she grows noticeably slimmer once she takes up fencing.

personality.text: Strong-willed; she does not simply give way to her husband.
